vocab.definition: speeds up a reaction without being used up.
the minimum energy for a successful collision.
a different route with a lower activation energy.

misconceptions.wrong: A catalyst is used up in the reaction.
misconceptions.right: A catalyst is unchanged and can be reused.
A catalyst LOWERS the activation energy.
It changes the rate, not the amount of product.

infoPanels.title: PROFILE WITH CATALYST
infoPanels.secondaryContent: A catalyst gives a route with a lower Eₐ (smaller hump).

questions.text: State what is meant by a catalyst. [1 mark]
Explain how a catalyst increases the rate of a reaction. [2 marks]
Explain why a catalyst is not included in the chemical equation. [2 marks]
Name the type of catalyst found in living things. [1 mark]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: A catalyst provides an alternative ______ with a lower activation energy, which ______ the energy needed.

questions.text: Suggest why catalysts are valuable in industry. [2 marks]

footer.tip: A catalyst lowers Eₐ so more collisions are successful — and it is reused.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why does a catalyst speed up the reaction without changing the energy released?
